name: L@VE ONCE
source:
Shouji has a secret that his mother is a mermaid. It's true. He met mermaids when he was a kid. One day, his father passes away.... Two months later, twin girls visit his house. Their names are May and Meru. Yes, they are actually mermaids he met before. Since his father died, he will be able to fall in love only once. Shouji is totally confused.... May and Meru say to him, "We'll support you, so enjoy your love...."

[From HimeyaShop]
translation:
翔司有一个秘密：他的母亲是美人鱼。这是真的，他小时候曾经见过美人鱼。一天，父亲去世了…两个月后，一对双胞胎少女来到他家。她们名叫梅与梅露，正是他从前遇见的美人鱼。父亲去世后，他一生将只能爱上一个人。翔司完全不知所措…梅与梅露对他说：“我们会支持你的，好好享受恋爱吧…”

[From HimeyaShop]
